Requires the Stranger Sins DLC.

Created by using [[Obsidian]] at the study table.

It can be used as an alternative for the [[Book|silver or gold books]] needed for the [[Astrologer|Astrologer's]] questline. Note that using the Obsidian Research in place of the silver or gold book in the Astrologer's questline will prevent you from getting the [[Achievements|Best Seller achievement]]
